units.source_text: 众妃嫔娘家的人，都来观赏踏歌。

en.t: The families of the ladies of the court all came to watch the dancing and singing.

units.source_text: 今天的会异常盛大，众女眷没有一个不妆饰得花团锦簇，重叠的袖口都很整齐。

en.t: The gathering today was exceptionally grand, and every woman was dressed in brilliant finery, with her layered sleeve edges neatly arranged.

units.source_text: 皇太子的母亲承香殿女御也打扮得花枝招展。

en.t: The Crown Prince's mother, the Kokiden Consort, was also adorned in dazzling splendor.

units.source_text: 皇太子年仅十二，但周身装饰都非常入时。

en.t: The Crown Prince was only twelve, but everything about his attire was remarkably fashionable.

units.source_text: 踏歌队先到御前，次赴秋好皇后宫，然后往朱雀院。

en.t: The dancing procession first went before the Emperor, then to Empress Akikonomu's palace, and afterward to Suzaku-in.

units.source_text: 本当再赴六条院，但夜已甚深，诸多不便，今年就免去了。

en.t: They were supposed to go on to Rokujo-in as well, but the night had grown very late and there were many inconveniences, so that visit was omitted this year.

units.source_text: 队伍从朱雀院回来，道经皇太子宫等处时，天色已明。

en.t: By the time the procession returned from Suzaku-in and passed places such as the Crown Prince's residence, dawn had already broken.

units.source_text: 在朦胧而渐渐发白的晨光中，踏歌人醉兴方酣，齐声唱出催马乐《竹川》之歌。

en.t: In the dim morning light that was slowly turning pale, the dancers were still happily drunk and sang the saibara song Takekawa in unison.

units.source_text: 内大臣家四五位公子都是殿上人中嗓子最好、容貌最美的少年，立刻参加合唱，歌声异常悦耳。

en.t: Four or five young lords from the Inner Minister's household, boys with the finest voices and handsomest looks among the courtiers, immediately joined the chorus, and their singing was exceptionally pleasing.

units.source_text: 殿上童子八郎君，是内大臣正妻所生，父母异常钟爱，相貌亦甚俊秀，与髭黑大将的长男媲美。

en.t: The court page Hachiro, born to the Inner Minister's principal wife, was deeply cherished by both parents, and his handsome features rivaled those of General Higekuro's eldest son.

units.source_text: 尚侍心知这八郎君是异母弟，对他另眼看待。

en.t: The Naishi no Kami knew in her heart that this Hachiro was her half brother, and she regarded him with special favor.
